I've planned four 5-second shots (20 s total). The working directory was empty, so there was no script or character sheet to work from. These are the assumptions I made:

**Assumptions**
- **Story setup.** The company runs a mining or quarry operation outside a town in Armenia. On day 6, the manager tells two foreign auditors that no blasting is taking place. Narine sits beside them and interprets. A blast goes off behind the ridge while he's talking. Only Narine notices, because she's the one person paying close attention to every word.
- **Model specs.** I don't have confirmed details for Seedance 2.5. I've assumed it works like Seedance 2.0: 5 s or 10 s clips, 16:9 at 1080p, a reference-image or first-frame input, and native audio. If your settings differ, use the closest match.
- **Dialogue.** It gets recorded and added in post. Lip-synced Armenian and English from the model isn't reliable, so the manager is framed in profile or soft focus and Narine speaks quietly. The prompts ask for room sound only.
- **Character looks.** I made these up. Replace them with your casting.

## How it's built to cut
| # | Time | Shot | Purpose | Cut out on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0–5 s | Wide, symmetrical, very slow push-in. Concrete conference room, manager at the window, Narine at the end of the table. | Shows the lie and the geography | The manager's raised hand / Narine's pen on the page |
| 2 | 5–10 s | Top-down insert of Narine's notepad. Her pen jolts mid-word and dust drifts down into the frame. | The shake, felt instead of shown | The stray ink stroke |
| 3 | 10–15 s | Close-up of Narine, 85 mm. She stops mid-sentence and her eyes go screen-right to the window. The manager talks on, out of focus. | She realises | Her eyeline to the window |
| 4 | 15–20 s | Over her right shoulder through the glass. A pale dust plume rises silently behind the far ridge, with her faint reflection in the window. | Confirms the blast. End of scene | Hold |

**Continuity rules (already written into the prompts)**
- **Screen direction.** Narine is always screen-left looking screen-right, and the window and manager are always screen-right. Every shot stays on that side of the 180° line.
- **Fixed description blocks.** The character, wardrobe and look blocks are pasted word-for-word into every prompt.
- **Same settings every time.** Use the same seed and the same Narine reference image for all four shots.
- **Edit.**
  - Start the low rumble about 12 frames before the cut from 1 to 2 (a J-cut). The shake should be heard before it's seen.
  - Duck the manager's voice under the rumble in shot 2 and bring it back, unbroken, in shot 3. He doesn't stop talking because he doesn't notice.
  - Shot 4 has no score: just room tone and a faint, delayed rumble from far away.
- **Grade.** Grade all four shots as one: muted teal-grey, lifted blacks, skin kept natural.

## FINAL

**Settings (all shots):** Seedance 2.5 · 16:9 · 1080p · 24 fps · 5 s · fixed seed (e.g. 260611) · reference image = Narine still (generate it first from the CHARACTER block) · motion strength low · native audio ON with ambient/SFX only and no dialogue or music.

**Paste into every prompt:**
> CHARACTER: Narine, Armenian woman, mid-30s, dark brown hair in a low tight bun, pale olive skin, no makeup, charcoal wool turtleneck, thin steel wristwatch, black ballpoint pen. Manager: Armenian man, late 50s, heavyset, grey stubble, navy suit, white shirt, no tie. Two foreign auditors in grey suits, seen only from behind.
> LOOK: Denis Villeneuve style, Roger Deakins-like cinematography. Brutalist raw-concrete office, floor-to-ceiling window, flat white overcast daylight, soft directionless light, muted desaturated teal-grey palette, deep negative space, restrained still camera, anamorphic 2.39-feel framing inside 16:9, fine film grain, quiet oppressive atmosphere.

**Shot 1 (0–5 s)**
> [CHARACTER] [LOOK] Wide symmetrical shot of a long concrete conference room on an upper floor, pale oak table running toward a huge window. Outside: barren brown mountain ridge under white sky. The manager stands in profile at the window, screen-right, calmly gesturing with one raised hand as he speaks. The two auditors sit with their backs to camera. Narine sits apart at the near end of the table, screen-left, facing right, quietly interpreting while writing on a notepad. Camera: static tripod with a barely perceptible slow push-in. Everything is still and controlled. Audio: low air-conditioning hum, distant wind against glass. Avoid: camera shake, fast motion, text, warm colors, extra people.

**Shot 2 (5–10 s)**
> [CHARACTER] [LOOK] Top-down close insert of Narine's notepad on the pale oak table: neat handwritten Armenian script, her hand and black pen mid-word. A sudden deep tremor jolts the table. The pen skids, leaving a long stray ink stroke across the line. A thin glass of water at the frame edge trembles in rings. Fine concrete dust drifts down through the grey window light onto the page. Her hand freezes. Camera: locked off, the only motion is the tremor. Audio: deep subsonic boom felt more than heard, glass rattle, faint creak of concrete. Avoid: explosion visuals, flames, cracks, fast cuts, text overlays.

**Shot 3 (10–15 s)**
> [CHARACTER] [LOOK] Close-up of Narine, 85mm, very shallow depth of field, screen-left of frame, facing right. She stops speaking mid-sentence, lips slightly parted. Her eyes slowly lift and turn screen-right toward the window. A quiet, horrified understanding. Minimal movement, one held breath. Out of focus in the background, the manager keeps talking and gesturing, unaware. Camera: slow steady push-in toward her eyes. Soft flat window light on the right side of her face. Audio: room tone, a fading low rumble, a muffled indistinct male voice continuing. Avoid: crying, dramatic expressions, camera shake, lip-sync close-ups of the manager.

**Shot 4 (15–20 s)**
> [CHARACTER] [LOOK] Over-the-shoulder shot from behind Narine's right shoulder, her dark bun soft in the foreground screen-left, looking through the floor-to-ceiling window. Far away, behind the barren mountain ridge, a slow, silent column of pale grey dust rises into the flat white sky and spreads. Her faint reflection is visible in the glass over the landscape. Camera: static, hold. Vast scale, tiny human figure, ominous calm. Audio: near silence, wind on glass, one very distant delayed low rumble. Avoid: fire, debris, people outside, sun, bright colors, camera movement.

**Edit:** cut 1→2 on the manager's raised hand, with the rumble J-cut 12 frames early. Cut 2→3 on the ink stroke. Cut 3→4 on her eyeline. Hold the last frame of shot 4 for about 10 extra frames, then cut to black.
